run_notification_service: run the notification service script to parse CI test results and post reports to Slack
handle_test_results: handle test results by parsing CI output strings and returning failed, errors, success, skipped counts and time spent
retrieve_artifact: retrieve test result artifacts from a local directory and parse them into a dictionary keyed by filename
retrieve_available_artifacts: retrieve available CI artifacts from the current directory and categorize them by name and GPU type
prepare_reports: prepare formatted reports with title, header, and report lines for Slack messages with optional truncation
